text:
alex: noticed elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate from canary group ~2m ago. dashboard shows error spikes from pod set canary-rl-4.

maria: thanks alex. which cluster/zone?

alex: eu-west-1a, cluster=gold-dataplane, canary deployment id=deploy-2026-03-15-17.

jamal: paging oncall. @maria you oncall?

maria: yes I'm oncall. looking. pulling logs.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-199876 (high 5xx rate — canary). Pager: maria.

maria: seeing crashloop in canary pods. liveness failing with SIGTERM during shutdown handler. stack trace refers to kv-cache flush timing.

ken: is this the new liveness change from last rollout? the release changed SIGTERM grace handling and probe timings.

alex: correct — PR #4521 shortened terminationGracePeriod and moved readiness->liveness probe.

sophia: can we abort canary via flag? feature-flag service shows flag deploy-kill-switch exists.

maria: trying kill-switch now. hitting deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: @maria received kill-switch request: flag=deploy.canary.abort, scope=canary-rl-4, requested_by=maria. Starting rollout revert across canary group.

maria: applying revert hook, toggling flag to OFF.

alex: observed 1 pod evicting then new old image coming up. logs show graceful shutdown still tries to flush KV for up to 15s then SIGKILL. Crashloop caused by process taking longer than new probe window and then restart.

jamal: what customer impact? SLOs?

maria: initial blast affected ~8% of traffic routed to canary; TLDR: transient 5xx increase, median latency for embeddings routes for some dedicated customers increased 50-100ms due to retries. No full outage. Some single-request 503s for 2 customers for ~5 minutes.

ken: noted — inform Customer Success for the two affected customers and add postmortem tag. cc @sophia.

sophia: on it. will draft customer message: short summary, mitigation, next steps.

alex: rolling out automatic fallback policy? traffic should route away from canary while flag is off. confirm routing change.

maria: routing shows canary weight dropped to 0 within 30s of flag toggle. 5xx rate back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary abort complete. Reverted probe config to previous stable revision: rs=stable-2026-03-10-7.

jamal: great. are there any remaining crashloops on other nodes?

maria: scanning cluster: a couple pods in other AZs show increased restart count but are stable now. No ongoing degradations.

alex: quick reproduce steps for postmortem: 1) apply new liveness/probe trifecta in PR 4521 -> 2) deploy to canary -> 3) SIGTERM handler flush path takes > terminationGracePeriod -> 4) pod restarted -> readiness fails -> traffic hits fallback -> increased 5xx and retries.

ken: immediate action items: (a) revert probe change in CI for next deploy, (b) add grace-period to SIGTERM handler in code path, (c) add canary-level circuit-breaker to autoscale routing, (d) run a small controlled canary test with long-running KV flush sim.

maria: I'm creating a ticket: INF-7263 with logs/links. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, and eng-ml.

sophia: CS message drafted and sent to the two customers, offering postmortem and credits.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-15-199876 updated: severity=SEV3, state=mitigated.

jamal: handing off to oncall rotation for follow-ups. maria you want to stay on the ticket?

maria: I'll follow through with INF-7263 and coordinate fix. handing active pager to next oncall at 1998765875.

ken: thanks team. create postmortem draft and include timeline + the exact probe diffs.

alex: note: add an e2e that simulates long KV flush during SIGTERM so we catch this earlier.

sophia: adding customer-impact notes to the ticket.

maria: closing slack thread. will update when root cause verified. :white_check_mark:
